requirements.description: JWT-based authentication: register, login, refresh, OAuth (Google), OTP password reset
openQuestions: Rate limiting per IP? Refresh token rotation interval?

requirements.description: Role-based access control: FOUNDER (full), DEVELOPER (code/view), VIEWER (read-only)
Project CRUD: create, read, update, delete projects with member management
openQuestions: Soft-delete or hard-delete? Cascading member removal?

requirements.description: Repo configuration: GET/PUT /api/projects/{id}/repo with repoUrl, repoProvider enum, repoBranch, repoTokenRef
openQuestions: Credential storage — env var only for MVP? HashiCorp Vault in Phase 2?

requirements.description: Repo config validation: repoUrl must be non-empty when provider is set; provider must be valid enum value
Gate status endpoint: GET /api/projects/{id}/branches/{branch}/gate-status returns test/compliance/coordinated gates
openQuestions: Should gate status be cached? TTL?

requirements.description: Latest test/compliance results: GET .../test-results/latest and .../compliance-results/latest
Bootstrap project: POST /api/orchestrator/bootstrap creates project from prompt with Spring+React skeleton
openQuestions: Should bootstrap trigger real git push or only local generation for MVP?

requirements.description: Audit logging: append-only log for all user and agent actions with simulation flag
openQuestions: Retention policy? Auto-archive older than 90 days?

requirements.description: Usage metering: count agent runs per user/month; block at tier limit with 402 error
openQuestions: What happens to in-flight agent runs when limit is hit mid-request?

requirements.description: Simulated sprint orchestration: run 5 agents (BA, Architect, Dev, Tester, Compliance) in simulation mode synchronously
openQuestions: Should sprint support async execution with webhook callback in Phase 2?

requirements.description: Sprint input validation: reject empty changeDescription, missing project, unsupported branch
Sprint defaults branch to 'main' when null/unspecified
Sprint persists TestResult and ComplianceResult entities with simulation=true, correlationId, branch
openQuestions: Should sprint also persist intermediate BA/Architect/Dev outputs for traceability?

requirements.description: Sprint evaluates all three quality gates (test, compliance, coordinated) after agents complete
Sprint response includes structured BA summary (req count, AC count), Architect summary (components, feasibility, risks), Dev summary (file changes, rationale, risk level)
parseOrFallback() handles malformed LLM JSON gracefully: logs warning, returns empty DTO instance, does NOT crash sprint
DeepSeekAgentClient sends correctly formatted chat/completions request with system prompt, user context, model, temperature, max_tokens, and Bearer auth
openQuestions: Should we support multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) via strategy pattern?

requirements.description: DeepSeekAgentClient parses response choices[0].message.content into raw string for downstream DTO parsing
DeepSeekAgentClient handles HTTP errors: 429, 500, connection timeout — returns error JSON, no uncaught exception
openQuestions: Should 429 trigger automatic retry with exponential backoff?

requirements.description: DeepSeekAgentClient handles malformed/partial LLM response (missing choices, empty array, non-JSON) — returns raw response as fallback, no NPE
DeepSeekAgentClient unavailable (no API key) returns error JSON without making HTTP call
Conditional bean wiring: DeepSeekAgentClient active when DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set; StubLLMAgentClient active when key absent
DeepSeek context assembly: user message includes projectTitle, changeDescription, requirements, acceptanceCriteria, architectureSpec as applicable
openQuestions: Should context include repo file listing when available?

requirements.description: BaRequirementsOutput: parse requirements[] with id, area, description, risk (BusinessCritical/High/Medium/Low), qualityAttributes[], openQuestions[]
openQuestions: Should risk levels map to numeric weights for sprint scoring?

requirements.description: ArchitectDesignOutput: parse components[], services[], dataFlows[], feasibility, assumptions, tradeOffs, risks
DevImplementOutput: parse filesToChange[] (path, action, summary, riskLevel), rationale, riskLevel, storyId, testCoverage, needsHuman
openQuestions: Should filesToChange include line numbers or code snippets?

requirements.description: TesterOutput: parse testsRun, testsPassed, testsFailed, testsSkipped, coveragePercent, overallStatus, doDMet, failures[]
ComplianceOutput: parse overallStatus, severity, riskLevel, reportUrl, checksPassed[], checksFailed[], findings[], needsHuman
openQuestions: Should compliance reports link to specific DPDP/GDPR regulation IDs?

requirements.description: All DTOs use @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true) for tolerance to LLM extra fields
StubLLMAgentClient returns valid placeholder JSON for all 5 prompt keys; returns error for unknown keys
PromptCatalog loads 5 prompts from agent_prompts.yaml; supports {{variable}} substitution
openQuestions: Should prompts support multi-language (Hindi, Tamil) in Phase 2?

requirements.description: TestResult entity: projectId, agentRunId, testsRun/Passed/Failed/Skipped, coveragePercent, failuresJson, status, correlationId, branch, simulation, timestamps
ComplianceResult entity: projectId, agentRunId, checksPassedJson, checksFailedJson, overallStatus, severity, reportUrl, correlationId, branch, simulation
GateEvaluation entity: projectId, gateType (TEST/COMPLIANCE/COORDINATED), passed, testResultId, complianceResultId, correlationId, details, branch, simulation
openQuestions: Should gate evaluations be compressed/aggregated for long history?

requirements.description: Flyway migration V6: create test_results, compliance_results, gate_evaluations tables; add simulation column to audit_logs
RepoWorkspaceService directory structure: {workspace}/{projectId}/{source, plans, patches, logs}
openQuestions: Should workspace dirs be cleaned up after sprint completes? Retention policy?

requirements.description: AuditLog records simulation flag; simulated actions use _SIMULATED suffix (e.g., GATE_TEST_EVALUATE_SIMULATED)
Quality & Agents frontend tab: gate status cards (pass/fail chips), simulation indicator (SIM badge), timestamps, latest test/compliance results
openQuestions: Should the tab auto-refresh every N seconds?

requirements.description: Gate status endpoint returns all three gate types + overall pass/fail for a given project+branch
Simulation flag propagates from event payload → AgentEventListener → RepoWorkspaceService; skips real git operations, logs _SIMULATED audit entries
openQuestions: Should simulation mode be configurable per-project in the UI?

requirements.description: Simulation flag defaults to false when absent from event payload

unclearOrMissingRequirements: No requirement for frontend user authentication flow (login screen, token storage, auto-refresh). The Flutter app exists but auth flow requirements are not captured here.
No requirement for real git push/PR creation — only simulation mode implemented. Real git operations are stubbed/prepared but not wired.
No requirement for LLM rate limiting / queue management when multiple sprints fire simultaneously.
No requirement for sprint cancellation mid-execution.
No requirement for data export / compliance report download.
No requirement for WebSocket / real-time push of gate status updates to frontend.
No requirement for multi-tenant isolation guarantees (data separation between projects).
No requirement for CI/CD pipeline integration (auto-trigger sprint on PR creation).
